'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Blake Huffman DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Blake Huffman]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Header player Blake only; paired LS is Blake Huffman. Sheet title Rooster.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Blake Huffman]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[ISB Operations / Reaching Out|ISB Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
